purpose: Reduce bounded work-transfer packets into one FIELD attention condition without creating a second queue, dashboard, authority source, or universal object store.

packet_fields.OBJECT: Exact addressed thing being carried. Required.
packet_fields.AUTHORITY: Who may interpret or mutate the thing. Required. Recency never implies CURRENT authority.
packet_fields.STATE_IN: Optional pre-operation state or state reference.
packet_fields.DELTA: Material change asserted by this packet. A DELTA without evidence reduces to RESIDUE, not truth.
packet_fields.EVIDENCE: References sufficient to support the packet's claimed delta or disposition.
packet_fields.STATE_OUT: Returned state after the bounded move.
packet_fields.RESIDUE: Unresolved returned work, ambiguity, defect, contradiction, or unproved claim.
packet_fields.WAITING: External human/device/world/private prerequisite. WAITING never occupies NOW merely because it exists.
packet_fields.NEXT: At most three lawful candidate moves. NEXT is OFFER_ONLY and never inherits authority from the previous move.

buckets.NOW: Explicit current authority/attention. Derived only from an authoritative current marker, never from time, branch, chat, or manifest freshness.
buckets.DELTA: Evidenced material change that should be surfaced but does not itself become NOW.
buckets.RESIDUE: Returned unresolved work, contradiction, failed proof, malformed NEXT, or material delta lacking evidence.
buckets.GATE: External prerequisite that must be parked until its trigger occurs. GATE != ACTIVE_FRONT.
buckets.NEXT: One to three lawful candidate moves with no inherited execution authority.
buckets.ARCHIVE: Closed, non-actionable, or invalid/quarantined packet. Successful CLOSE disappears from ordinary attention.

return_reduction.TRIGGER: NEXT when 1..3 lawful moves are present; otherwise ARCHIVE

laws: UNREADABLE OR INVALID FIELDS CANNOT ALTER CONTROL.
CURRENT OWNS NOW. Git owns literal mutation chronology. Manifest touch is only addressed projection evidence.
RETURN CLOSES THE PREVIOUS MOVE; NEXT IS A FRESH OFFER, NOT INHERITED AUTHORITY.
SUCCESSFUL CLOSE DISAPPEARS FROM ORDINARY ATTENTION.
FIELD is the sole ordinary aggregation interface; this reducer is a pure mechanism behind existing CATCH / ACT and control projections.

implementation.host: FIELD INDEX root / existing CATCH + ACT surface
